dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, high-contrast horizontal white bands are visible across the median and greater coverts, characterized by thick white feather margins against dark centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary sharpness of thick white margins on the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, broad white scalloping across the entire dorsal surface of the bird from the mantle through the tail coverts.
